binary.address_kind: preferred-base virtual addresses, not file offsets or RVAs
binary.scope: Base-game client only; not validated against Sabre Squadron

method: Static analysis of a separate Ghidra project. Function roles are research interpretations, not recovered original names. No game execution or baseline-project edits.

functions.evidence: Initializes runtime state, reads command line and STARTUPINFO, obtains the module handle, calls 006dd550, and handles its return value.
Called from runtime startup; enforces a single-instance mutex, invokes prerequisites and 006dcae0, and restores system settings. Inferred prototype is not trustworthy yet.
Allocates the controller, initializes platform services, loops over timing and update calls, invokes GetIGraph and I3DGetDriver interfaces, and performs shutdown.
Calls TEV, reads LS3D_setup from the game registry key, invokes 006db0f0, configures the window, and reads window.cfg.

Constructs a settings block from stored configuration, checks command-line options, and passes the settings to the first virtual method of GetIGraph's interface. This is interface initialization, not proven object creation.
Initializes controller fields; on the normal startup branch calls 006b65d0, 006b6620 and 006c0ca0.
First tests alternate startup through 006c0af0; otherwise creates an object and starts Logo1.bik.
Reads GetCommandLineA, references '-cmd ' and 'exec %s', and creates an alternate state. Exact semantics of all options remain unverified.
Uses QueryPerformanceCounter/Frequency, converts elapsed time to milliseconds, bounds the interval, and waits on a timer/event when below the minimum.
Accumulates supplied time at controller+0x18; at 100 or above subtracts 100 and conditionally invokes state vtable+0x10 with argument 100. This does not prove a game-wide or AI tick rate.

functions.role: Controller per-frame update and state-transition dispatch
functions.evidence: Invokes active-state virtual methods, dispatches returned state codes, and handles logo/intro/credits and other state changes. It is not a pure renderer.

functions.role: Construct and activate a state selected from a descriptor
functions.evidence: Destroys the previous controller+0x14 state and selects several constructors/vtables using descriptor fields. Exact state names are not established.
Selects a mission identifier, calls 006ca780 on loading paths, and then performs substantial gameplay-state initialization. Incoming virtual dispatch is not yet resolved.
Calls loading-screen setup, scene loading and scene2 handling; references missions\%s\tree.klz and calls the effects-loading function. Best next investigation entry.
Calls 006c9640, stores the selected mission identifier, and resets several resource-related objects.
References missions\%s\loader, C_LoaderScreen, text_h&dversion, and loadbar.

functions.role: Load mission Scene resource via engine interface
functions.evidence: Builds missions\%s\Scene and passes it with a callback and flags to the scene object's virtual method at byte offset 0xf4. Original engine method name remains unknown.
References missions\%s\scene2.bin and performs additional scene setup. Stack recovery is poor; complete parsing semantics are not established.

unresolved: The exact frontend/controller virtual-dispatch path into 006989b0 is not established; the two graph components must not be joined by an invented direct call.
Vtable types, original function names, and many inferred calling conventions remain unknown.
Opaque calls through 00a59000 and arithmetic around them occur in setup and loading paths; their meaning is unresolved.
Successful decompilation is not proof of correct stack recovery. Several scene-loading exports contain implausible stack variables and unreachable-block warnings.
006d1ba0 also references scene2.bin and appears to contain chunk-reading logic, but its role relative to 006cbf30 is not established.
Archive contents have not been extracted or matched to these paths, and no runtime behavior has been verified.
next_milestone: Inspect extracted scene2.bin and Scene resources for one known mission; recover loader helper signatures and validate the loading stages against the original running under Proton.
